profile.summary:
I am passionate about software development and solving challenging problems, and more often than not the two overlap and are always very rewarding. I pride myself with my ability to take on challenges in new areas and to quickly embrace new technologies, which has proven vital throughout my education and employment.

To my colleagues and clients, I am a very creative and reliable hard worker always willing to go the extra mile to not only deliver the solution, but provide a smooth and consistent user experience.
